summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only ("attempt to write a readonly database"), so POST /orders returns 500 and the ledger sync fails. The underlying cause is unknown, probably a file permission, disk or mount problem.
recommended: A human should restore write access to the database: check file or volume permissions, whether the disk is full, and whether the filesystem was remounted read-only.
Once writes work, run check_invariants and confirm that ledger sync resumes.
Don't roll back v1.3: the timing doesn't match, and a restart or config change won't fix a read-only DB.
